request.description: launch starts a game; attach connects to a game started from the Godot editor window (open editor, then press Play). cwd, args, envs and stop_on_entry are ignored: Godot's debug launch takes no arguments.

scene.description: "main" runs the project's main scene, "current" runs the scene of the file given in "file", or a res:// path to a .tscn scene, e.g. res://scenes/main.tscn.

file.description: Path of the .gd or .tscn file used by scene "current". A .tscn is normalised to its res:// path; a .gd runs the scene of that script.
